translations.web: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear Yahweh’s law;
translations.bsb: These are rebellious people, deceitful children, children unwilling to obey the LORD’s instruction.
translations.kjv: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the LORD:
